title: analytics/engagement-stub.json — per-comic engagement record (the flywheel landing pad)
description: The Publisher → Ideator contract (VISION §4): which comic went where and how it performed, captured over time. prepare_post.py seeds it with empty captures[] + a capture plan; capture passes append entries. Wiring the capture is Wave-2 — the SHAPE is defined now so every stub is forward-compatible. How each source is read (wrappers only, never raw secrets): references/analytics-capture.md.

release_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; capture windows anchor to this

capture_plan.description: Intended passes (e.g. release +7d, +30d). A plan entry without a matching capture = a pass still owed.

captures.description: Append-only. One entry per (source, capture moment). Null metric = not available from that source, absent metric = not applicable.

source_detail.description: e.g. GA4 property id (GrowGetter 303340242, MaxxMuscle 329224171; Bloom has NO GA4), Patreon campaign id (GG 3138139, Maxx 8794850, Bloom 11913067, 3DMC 15535167), or the post URL measured

window_days.description: Days since release this capture covers; null for point-in-time platform counters

metrics.description: All optional; capture what the source exposes.

watchers_delta.description: DA watchers / followers gained over the window
